title: PROSOCIALALIGN: PREFERENCE CONDITIONED TEST TIME ALIGNMENT IN LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models with 'prosocial' human values such as empathy, truthfulness, and a non-judgmental stance. It evaluates model performance on ethically sensitive and 'unethical' topics, including suicide prevention, mental health, and discrimination, explicitly aiming to improve the moral and ethical quality of AI interactions.
